Post-v5.0 hardening wave + cross-adopter harvest (both PCs' divergence audits folded UP).
- Council remediation (87 findings) + next-day full-codebase sweep (14 more, all fixed): secret-scanner staged scan now catches renamed-modified files (ACM→ACMRT) and no longer skips >1MB files (64MB maxBuffer fail-open); model-runner win32 shell-injection fix (execFileSync argv); createMemory collision guard; searchMemories recordRecall opt-out for diagnostics; daily-log worktree-root fix; symlink-aware readdir in skill-resolution/skill-evolution; fleet sync --prune-orphans now zone-gated (can no longer delete adopter-owned brand-guidelines files).
- fleet:diverge hardened on first fleet-wide live runs: historicalHeads Set-input crash, headIdentity fence-strip normalization, whole-file title-down rewrites classified preserved, per-adopter decision-sheet filenames (no same-minute clobber).
- skill-merger: fence-aware re-anchoring in reinsertFencedBlocks + headingLines (third fence-blind fix — template sections whose body is a markdown code example no longer swallow adopter fences).
- Harvested from 4 adopters: run-tests.md chrome-MCP agents must be the claude agent type (general-purpose has no MCP tools/ToolSearch) + ToolSearch one-call loading + per-agent tab isolation + standing post-deploy browser gate; run-todo.md CLASS CLOSURE, VERIFY-THE-PROPERTY, gate-hang escalation, adversarial/evasive fixture rules, TEST SELF-VERIFY false-green block (also in do.md); qa-engineer evasive-fixture rule; guardrail-rules tsconfig*.json unfrozen (vitest.config precedent); Mfa.Hub's 8: policy-list PR watch, Gated File Access checklist, planning rules 6-8, do.md branch pre-flight, VAULT placeholder, work/todo subfolder tolerance, findings/bug-triage path row, CSO casing fixes.
- code-review playbook: fixture-masked read-path refactor defect class (differential eval +12.5 pts).

--- v5.0 ---
Fleet divergence-harvest system, lint-gated builds, and a wave of cross-project improvements folded UP into the template.
- NEW fleet:diverge (npm run fleet:diverge): a read-only pre-sync divergence audit that finds an adopter's LOCAL edits to shared template files worth harvesting UP before a sync overwrites them. Compares by CONTENT IDENTITY (a file's blob SHA vs every historical workshop blob for that path), not a version baseline — so a stale adopter is never mis-flagged as diverged just for lagging a version. Writes a decision sheet; agents/settings are excluded (personalization a sync already preserves).
- gate.js now runs a LINT leg folded into `gate.js test` — a lint failure finally fails the gate at commit time instead of surfacing later in a code-review pass or CI (post-push). Same graceful-missing contract as the e2e leg: a project with no lint script configured just skips it. Adds an ESLint "stylish"-formatter parser to parseBuildOutput.
- Harvested generic improvements (from a fleet:diverge pass across adopters): memory-lint hyphen-guard (drops bare single-word "ref:" prose false-positives), skill-conformance symlink-dir guard (symlinked skill dirs now counted), session_id on telemetry records (isolate a session's own command chain), a dead-skill-link fix in code-review/two-stage-review, the todo.md H2-not-H3 split rule (nested-H3 splits were invisible to status.js --regen-master), check-sync per-agent read-only enforcement, two QA test-design patterns (cross-item field uniqueness, concurrent-caller TOCTOU), and command-workflow wisdom in /do + /run-todo + /retro (mirror-pattern precondition, mid-epic cross-wave checkpoint, cross-wave write-ownership review, numeric-Key-Decision recomputation, prior-retro + Path-A gap-closure checks).

--- v4.97 ---
Toolkit reference docs relocated to docs/reference/agents/ + README/LICENSE mirror.
- The toolkit's own wayfinding docs (commands.md, system-map.md, customization.md, getting-started.md, concepts/, guides/) moved from docs/reference/ root to docs/reference/agents/ — this now cleanly separates the toolkit's reference material from a project's own reference docs (onboarding.md, glossary.md, links.md), which stay at docs/reference/ root and would otherwise collide once scaffolded.
- docs/reference/agents/ also carries a self-contained mirror of README.md + LICENSE (root originals unchanged — GitHub's landing-page render and license detection both depend on root placement) with relative links rewritten for the new location, so the reference bundle is complete wherever it's scaffolded.
